advisory.heading: When you put the text in sections and lists
advisory.text: When a technical noun is not in the base list and not in the glossary, add a warning.

advisory.heading: When you put the text in sections and lists
advisory.text: When the glossary gives a base-list term a different meaning, use the glossary meaning.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/technical-terms.md line 29, the rule writes again the condition of its heading "When the glossary gives a different meaning" (line 27).

advisory.heading: When you select the text
advisory.text: When the edit job changes this skill, add a term to the base list only when most projects use the term in Agent instructions.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/technical-terms.md line 17, the changed rule makes the agent decide whether "most projects" use a term, but the rule gives no cause for this limit.
advisory.correction: "When the edit job changes this skill, add a term to the base list only when most projects use the term in Agent instructions. The base list is applicable to each project that uses this skill."

advisory.heading: When you put the text in sections and lists
advisory.text: If the project has a glossary, recommend a glossary entry in the format of the project.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/technical-terms.md lines 35 to 37, items 1 and 2 are two alternatives for two different conditions, and item 3 is a rule for both, so the numbered list gives no sequence of steps.
advisory.correction: Write the 3 items as bullets: "- If the project has a glossary, recommend a glossary entry in the format of the project.", "- If the project has no glossary, recommend a new `GLOSSARY.md` with a short structure: the term and its definition.", and the third item without a number.
